description: This source file implements the server loop logic for managing virtual machine snapshots, suspending/resuming guests, and executing commands related to crosvm and adb within the Android Open Source Project's cuttlefish virtualization environment.

classes.name: ServerLoopImpl
classes.description: Implements server loop functionalities for managing VM snapshots, suspending/resuming guests, and executing commands within the cuttlefish virtualization environment.

methods.name: InitializeVmToControlSockPath
methods.description: Initializes a map from VM names to their control socket paths based on the configuration.

methods.name: SuspendGuest
methods.description: Suspends the guest VM, particularly handling openwrt in crosvm.

methods.name: ResumeGuest
methods.description: Resumes the guest VM, particularly handling openwrt in crosvm.

methods.name: HandleSuspend
methods.description: Handles the process of suspending the guest and host processes.

methods.name: HandleResume
methods.description: Handles the process of resuming the guest and host processes.

methods.name: TakeCrosvmGuestSnapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of a crosvm guest based on provided JSON metadata.

methods.name: TakeGuestSnapshot
methods.description: Parses a JSON file and takes a guest snapshot depending on the VM manager.

methods.name: HandleSnapshotTake
methods.description: Handles the snapshot taking process triggered by SnapshotTake message.
